cost: Pure helpers O(args/features/input bytes). folds clones/writes O(k*document bytes), retains one partition at a time. Context validation O(tokens), generation/shuffle as ctx model. Evaluation/training cost delegated; output accumulation can be full-file or full-report. No cost cap on user counts/epochs/beam.
description: English CLI dispatch and adapters for evaluation, context wiring, file transforms, conversion and saved annotators. Most model/training paths remain explicitly unexecuted.
forward: Dispatch matches command and selected arity guards; train gates licenses before requiring output. Pure split uses first global -- then slices from index (panic if separator precedes from). xpos_of maps UPOS/features in ordered cases. folds rejects k<2 before read, assigns newdoc groups d%k, creates output dir and writes fold/rest per f. test_ctx None returns before file read; remaining branches read doc then validate shapes, optional pass1 then derive/shuffle then mask.
inverse: R(xpos VB) includes VERB/AUX with Inf even if Past also set; R(split) admits original prefix command, same train/rest and first separator, but paths lose original OS encoding through String args. Fold/rest pair recovers selected sentence multiset/order under known k/document assignment but not leading blanks/final-newline framing.
limitations: Training, model load/save/annotation, real corpus evaluation, teachers and APIs not executed
Missing args on expert-check can index-panic; split invalid from/separator can panic
Environment fraction accepts negative/NaN rather than validating claimed 0..1 domain
Report/schema/data adapters are source-derived outside bounded helpers
state: Arguments/environment, file paths, sentence/context vectors, delegated models and output streams/files.
